items.title: U.S. Bancorp (USB) Expands Business Banking Into Four Sun Belt States
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE: USB) announced a significant expansion of its business banking operations into Florida, Georgia, Texas, and Arizona. The move targets mid-sized businesses in Sun Belt states where U.S. Bank currently has a limited presence. The expansion includes a sizable hiring effort as the company seeks a broader national footprint.
